questions.stem: Where does urine go after leaving the collecting duct?

options.text: Back into the blood via the renal vein
Into the renal pelvis and then the ureter
Into the loop of Henle for further processing
Directly into the bladder via the renal artery

questions.explanation: After passing through the collecting duct, urine drains into the renal pelvis at the centre of the kidney, then travels down the ureter to the bladder for storage before being excreted.
